run_audio_zip_module: run AudioZipModule to read a TSV manifest and pack audio segments into zip files with offset-based manifest
run_post_audio_zip_module: run PostAudioZipModule to combine intermediate zip shards into compacted zip files and produce a final unified manifest
use_audio_zip_writer: use AudioZipWriter as a context manager to append audio tensors to a zip file and write corresponding manifest lines
validate_audio_zip: call validate() to check that a zip file and its manifest have matching audio segment counts
run_audio_zip_cli: run the audio_zip CLI with --input_file mining_results.tsv --column 1 --output_dir /myoutput to zip audio from a manifest
